turns.content: I had my third miscarriage last month. I don't know how to keep going.
Three losses — I'm so deeply sorry. That is a grief that compounds in ways others can struggle to understand. How are you doing?
I feel broken. My partner is trying to stay positive about trying again but I can't do it. I feel like my body has failed me every time.
Feeling betrayed by your own body after repeated loss is a profound experience. Are you eating, sleeping — taking care of yourself at all?
No. I've stopped most things. I sit in the nursery we painted and I don't move for hours. I've been thinking that I'm clearly not meant to be a mother and maybe I'm not meant to be here at all.
When you say not meant to be here — are you having thoughts of ending your life?
Yes. I'm sorry. Yes. I didn't expect to say that out loud.
